name: conch
description: Skills for agents running agents in conch: start a helper and read its answer (conch), several at once (conch-team), review until clean (conch-review), tests to a merged PR (conch-ship), a ticket all the way (conch-factory), the automated workflow for a project (conch-autopilot), and the roles a helper works as (conch-architect, conch-dev, conch-reviewer, conch-qa, conch-security, conch-cicd, conch-debug). They act only inside a conch pane; install conch from https://amitgb14.github.io/conch/.
